items.title: Bay Area First-Come · Oakland · 15 units · deadline 2026-12-22
items.en_title: Oakland first-come closes December 22: 15 three-bedroom affordable rentals
items.en_oneliner: Fifteen three-bedrooms in Oakland close December 22, first-come — large family-sized units are scarce across the Bay Area, so households needing extra bedrooms should apply early.
